$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ -2 & 4 & -1 & -6 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{2}\leftarrow R_{2}+2R_{1}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{3}\leftarrow R_{3}-R_{1}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{4}\leftarrow R_{4}+R_{1}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{3}\leftarrow R_{3}+R_{2}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{4}\leftarrow R_{4}-R_{2}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}
$$

Apply $R_{4}\leftarrow R_{4}-R_{3}$:

$$
A\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The leading nonzero entries are in columns $1, 3, 4$. Select the corresponding columns from the **original matrix**, giving $B=\{a_{1},\;a_{3},\;a_{4}\}$:

$$
B=\left\{\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\;\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ -1 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\;\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -6 \\ 3 \\ -5\end{bmatrix}\right\}.
$$

These pivot columns are linearly independent and span the column space of $A$, which is $S$. The nonpivot columns can be removed without changing the span.
